    Jeff Currie, CEO and founder at Real Macro and senior adviser at Carlyle, says gold’s retreat reflects a shortage of dollar liquidity. He also discusses the global oil industry in an interview with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
    Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas on Her Company Vision
    Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss her vision for the company since taking over the helm two months ago, how she plans to strategize the company’s business and more. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Tanker Hits Cruise Ship in New Orleans, Triggering Rescue
    A tanker collided with a docked river cruise ship on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, leaving the smaller vessel partly submerged and setting off a rescue operation. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
    US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control, an extraordinary action that threatens to disrupt travel across the globe. The Federal Aviation Administration said in an advisory notice on its website on Friday that the ground stop affects all US airports and departing flights should remain grounded until further notice. It cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.”  Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis reacts to the ongoing situation saying the ground stop is about de-conflicting traffic. (Source: Bloomberg)
    US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
    America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. Boston Fed Principal Economist and Policy Advisor Paul Willen says soaring construction costs are making many new housing projects financially unworkable, even after they’ve already won approval. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Investing in Financial Security: Masters in Business with Salim Ramji
    Barry speaks with Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji. They discuss his early career journey in law before transitioning to BlackRock as Head of Corporate Strategy and later taking over as the first "outsider" CEO of Vanguard. They also discuss Vanguard's recent acquisition of Altruist and what it means for the future of financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Flights Halted Across US, FAA Cites Safety Reasons
    US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control. Will Guisbond reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
    FAA Grounds All Flights Nationwide
    All flights in the US have been grounded. The Federal Aviation Administration cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety” for the ground stop, which affects all US airports. Bloomberg's Will Guisbond is following this breaking news. (Source: Bloomberg)

    Match Group Keeping AI Out of Dating
    Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a “human-only zone,” even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss where companies should draw the line on AI and how the technology is transforming Match Group. He also weighs ibn on Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia and why he thinks companies are ultimately bigger than any one CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

    Fed Sees Risks Tied to Elevated Asset Prices Partly Driven by AI
    The Federal Reserve on Friday flagged potential vulnerabilities stemming from artificial intelligence and elevated asset valuations in a semi-annual report on financial stability.
    Inside Jensen Huang’s Last Hours as Nvidia CEO
    Bloomberg's Ian King said that situation Jensen Huang put himself in after he had multiple affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, gave the former Nvidia CEO 'no choice' other than the resign from the company. King said that in his final days at the company Huang tried to 'cauterize the wounds' and accept responsibility, but that it ultimately wasn't enough. (Source: Bloomberg)

Brown, who is a former CIA officer, said that it is hard to know exactly how the woman accused of spying on Jensen Huang came to be involved, as China is good at identifying potential resources who may have inroads with business.     Everybody’s Business: China Is Writing Its Own AI Playbook
    While US AI companies are struggling with a public image problem, Chinese attitudes towards AI are generally more positive with the government leading the charge to turn its rural and inland regions into AI-driven manufacturing hubs. Brad Stone joins Stacey Vanek Smith and Max Chafkin on the Everybody’s Business podcast to discuss his factory tour of EV maker Zeekr and how China is writing its own AI story. (Source: Bloomberg)
    Lutnick Under Fire as Bessent Blames Commerce for Nvidia Crisis

Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations. After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Compared to the other countries we looked at, the governance of England’s social care system is confused and complex. Overlapping and unclear roles leave dangerous uncertainty around who is responsible for important decisions, contributing to the inertia around reform England has struggled with for decades.
